lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਚਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar jagatr mahi lochahi sabh jeeaa ||
lines.translation: Triumphant cheers greet me all across the world, and all beings yearn for me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: suprasa(n)n bhae satigur prabhoo kachh bighan na theeaa ||1||
lines.translation: The True Guru and God are totally pleased with me; no obstacle blocks my way. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਦਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa a(n)g daiaal prabh taa ke sabh daas ||
lines.translation: One who has the Merciful Lord God on his side - everyone becomes his slave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa vadiaaeeaa naanak gur paas ||2||12||30||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, O Nanak, glorious greatness rests with the Guru. ||2||12||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 ghar 5 chaupade ||
lines.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House, Chau-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: mrit ma(n)dal jag saajiaa jiu baaloo ghar baar ||
lines.translation: This perishable realm and world has been made like a house of sand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਗਦ ਬੂੰਦਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binasat baar na laagaee jiu kaagad boo(n)daar ||1||
lines.translation: In no time at all, it is destroyed, like the paper drenched with water. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun meree manasaa manai maahi sat dekh beechaar ||
lines.translation: Listen to me, people: behold, and consider this within your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidh saadhik girahee jogee taj gae ghar baar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Siddhas, the seekers, house-holders and Yogis have forsaken their homes and left. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਿ ਕਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa supanaa rain kaa taisaa sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: This world is like a dream in the night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਨਸੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਲਗਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: drisatimaan sabh binaseeai kiaa lagahi gavaar ||2||
lines.translation: All that is seen shall perish. Why are you attached to it, you fool? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਹੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਨੈਨ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa s bhaaee meet hai dekh nain pasaar ||
lines.translation: Where are your brothers and friends? Open your eyes and see!

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਚਾਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਾਲਸਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ik chaale ik chaalasahi sabh apanee vaar ||3||
lines.translation: Some have gone, and some will go; everyone must take his turn. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin pooraa satigur seviaa se asathir har duaar ||
lines.translation: Those who serve the Perfect True Guru, remain ever-stable at the Door of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai raakh paij muraar ||4||1||31||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave; preserve his honor, O Lord, Destroyer of ego. ||4||1||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਗਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: lokan keeaa vadiaaeeaa baisa(n)tar paagau ||
lines.translation: The glories of the world, I cast into the fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਨਾ ਤੇ ਬੋਲ ਕਰਾਗਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu milai piaaraa aapanaa te bol karaagau ||1||
lines.translation: I chant those words, by which I may meet my Beloved. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਇ ਤਉ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਗਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau prabh jeeu daiaal hoi tau bhagatee laagau ||
lines.translation: When God becomes Merciful, then He enjoins me to His devotional service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਹ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: lapat rahio man baasanaa gur mil ih tiaagau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My mind clings to worldly desires; meeting with the Guru, I have renounced them. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਅਤਿ ਘਨੀ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਮਾਗਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karau benatee at ghanee ihu jeeu homaagau ||
lines.translation: I pray with intense devotion, and offer this soul to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰਥ ਆਨ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਿਮਖ ਸੋਹਾਗਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: arath aan sabh vaariaa pri nimakh sohaagau ||2||
lines.translation: I would sacrifice all other riches, for a moment's union with my Beloved. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸੰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਗਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch sa(n)g gur te chhute dokh ar raagau ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru, I am rid of the five villains, as well as emotional love and hate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਜਾਗਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ridai pragaas pragat bhaiaa nis baasur jaagau ||3||
lines.translation: My heart is illumined, and the Lord has become manifest; night and day, I remain awake and aware. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran sohaagan aaiaa jis masatak bhaagau ||
lines.translation: The blessed soul-bride seeks His Sanctuary; her destiny is recorded on her forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਗਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tin paaiaa tan man seetalaagau ||4||2||32||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, she obtains her Husband Lord; her body and mind are cooled and soothed. ||4||2||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: laal ra(n)g tis kau lagaa jis ke vadabhaagaa ||
lines.translation: One is dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, by great good fortune.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mailaa kade na hovaee nah laagai daagaa ||1||
lines.translation: This color is never muddied; no stain ever sticks to it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਈਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh paaiaa sukhadaaeeaa miliaa sukh bhaai ||
lines.translation: He finds God, the Giver of peace, with feelings of joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਭੀਤਰੇ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj samaanaa bheetare chhodiaa nah jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Celestial Lord blends into his soul, and he can never leave Him. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaraa maraa nah viaapaee phir dookh na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Old age and death cannot touch him, and he shall not suffer pain again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਘਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pee a(n)mrit aaghaaniaa gur amar karaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, he is satisfied; the Guru makes him immortal. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: so jaanai jin chaakhiaa har naam amolaa ||
lines.translation: He alone knows its taste, who tastes the Priceless Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: keemat kahee na jaaeeai kiaa kahi mukh bolaa ||3||
lines.translation: Its value cannot be estimated; what can I say with my mouth? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal daras teraa paarabraham gun nidh teree baanee ||
lines.translation: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Supreme Lord God. The Word of Your Bani is the treasure of virtue.
